editorial.summary: A clear Ostarine starting point for cutting and recomp phases where lean mass, training output and a stronger finish all matter.
editorial.researchProfile: MK-2866 gives the plan a measured lean-mass foundation. Start here when the goal is to hold onto training quality while bringing body composition into tighter focus.
editorial.guidance: Build from the outcome you want next: add Cardarine for endurance-led cutting work, compare S-4 for a stronger finish, or step into a lean-mass option when the phase changes.
editorial.considerations: Compare the product facts, stack options and available OpenLab record before finalising the next product decision.

proposition.headline: Build a leaner training phase without losing the plot.
proposition.promise: MK-2866 puts lean-mass focus, clear product facts and a flexible stack starting point in one place.
proposition.differentiator: A clear Ostarine base with direct access to the available batch record.
proposition.mobileSummary: A lean-mass base for cutting and recomp.

editorial.summary: A strength-led Testolone format for a harder training block built around lean mass, lifting output and more intensity.
editorial.researchProfile: RAD-140 is the step-up when strength and lean mass need to become the main event. It gives an advanced build a more forceful centre than a light recomp-only approach.
editorial.guidance: Use RAD-140 as the intensity choice, then compare LGD-4033 for lean-mass emphasis, MK-677 for recovery support, or MENT for a heavyweight mass direction.
editorial.considerations: See the full product details and compare the intensity profile with the rest of the stack before adding it.

proposition.headline: Turn the next block up.
proposition.promise: RAD-140 brings serious strength and lean-mass focus to a training phase that needs more intensity.
proposition.differentiator: The 8 MG Testolone format for a more aggressive training phase.

editorial.summary: A Ligandrol option for a heavier lean-mass phase where size, strength and a more substantial build are the priority.
editorial.researchProfile: LGD-4033 anchors the lean-mass side of a bulk-focused plan. It is the product to compare when the next goal is more size without losing a clean, deliberate direction.
editorial.guidance: Pair the lean-mass decision with MK-677 when recovery matters, compare RAD-140 when intensity is the deciding factor, or keep MK-2866 in view for a balanced recomp base.
editorial.considerations: Use the comparison and stack views to decide whether lean mass, intensity or recovery should lead the next build.

proposition.headline: Give a mass phase real substance.
proposition.promise: LGD-4033 brings lean-mass focus and a more substantial build direction to the stack.
proposition.differentiator: A clear Ligandrol choice when size and strength move to the front of the plan.
proposition.mobileSummary: A lean-mass anchor for a heavier phase.

editorial.summary: An Ibutamoren format that brings appetite, sleep and recovery support into a hard-training plan.
editorial.researchProfile: MK-677 is the recovery builder in the range. It gives a strength or mass-led phase more room to recover, eat and return ready for the next session.
editorial.guidance: Use MK-677 beside LGD-4033 or RAD-140 when the build needs more recovery capacity, or alongside the peptide range when recovery is the whole story.
editorial.considerations: Compare recovery emphasis, serving format and the role it plays beside the main product before adding it.

proposition.headline: Build more recovery into the plan.
proposition.promise: MK-677 adds appetite, deeper-sleep and recovery support around demanding training blocks.
proposition.differentiator: A 90-serving Ibutamoren format that supports the work between hard sessions.

editorial.summary: A Cardarine option for cutting and recomp phases that need more endurance, output and body-composition focus.
editorial.researchProfile: GW-50156 is the endurance-led addition for customers who want a cut to feel more capable through demanding sessions.
editorial.guidance: Use it beside MK-2866 for a cutting base, compare S-4 for a stronger final phase, or keep it in a recomp build where training output matters.
editorial.considerations: Compare endurance focus with the strength, mass and finish options before making it part of the stack.

proposition.headline: Make the cut feel more capable.
proposition.promise: GW-50156 puts endurance and body-composition focus beside a leaner training goal.
proposition.differentiator: A Cardarine choice for customers who want output to keep up with the goal.
proposition.mobileSummary: Endurance support for cutting and recomp.

editorial.summary: An Andarine option for a cutting phase that wants more definition and a stronger final presentation.
editorial.researchProfile: S-4 is the finish-focused option to compare once the cutting base is already in place. It brings a more defined direction beside Ostarine and Cardarine.
editorial.guidance: Add S-4 after choosing the cutting base, then use the comparison drawer to see how it changes intensity and the stack outcome.
editorial.considerations: Review the full product detail and compare it with the broader cutting build before adding it.

proposition.headline: Sharpen the final phase.
proposition.promise: S-4 adds a definition-led choice when a cutting build needs a more focused finish.
proposition.differentiator: An Andarine option for a more defined cutting direction.
proposition.mobileSummary: A stronger finish for a cutting build.

editorial.summary: A higher-intensity YK-11 option for customers comparing size and strength choices at the bolder end of the range.
editorial.researchProfile: YK-11 gives a bulk-focused product search a higher-intensity comparison point beside LGD-4033 and RAD-140.
editorial.guidance: Use the compare view to decide whether lean mass, maximum intensity or recovery support should shape the next product choice.
editorial.considerations: Review the intensity profile and product facts before choosing it as part of a multi-product build.

proposition.headline: Compare the bolder side of a mass phase.
proposition.promise: YK-11 gives a size-and-strength build a higher-intensity option to weigh against the rest of the range.
proposition.differentiator: A bolder choice beside LGD-4033 and RAD-140.

editorial.summary: A focused S-23 option for a recomp phase that wants a stronger edge on strength and definition.
editorial.researchProfile: S-23 is a distinct comparison when a recomp plan needs more intensity than an Ostarine-led base alone.
editorial.guidance: Compare S-23 with MK-2866 and Cardarine to see whether the next phase should lean toward a cleaner balance or a harder definition-led profile.
editorial.considerations: Use the contribution summary and product comparison before adding it to a recomp build.

proposition.headline: Give recomp a harder edge.
proposition.promise: S-23 adds a more intense strength-and-definition choice to a recomp-led build.
proposition.differentiator: A focused alternative when a balanced recomp base needs more edge.
proposition.mobileSummary: A harder edge for focused recomp.

editorial.summary: A prohormone option for the harder finishing phase of a recomp build, with a lean, dry presentation at the centre of the story.
editorial.researchProfile: Epistane is the finish-focused comparison for customers taking an Ostarine and Cardarine base into a more intense final phase.
editorial.guidance: Keep it in the recomp comparison set, then see what it contributes beside an endurance-led or lean-mass-led addition.
editorial.considerations: Review the product detail and compare intensity before adding a prohormone option to the build.

proposition.headline: Finish a recomp phase with intent.
proposition.promise: Epistane brings a harder, leaner finishing direction to an established recomp build.
proposition.differentiator: A prohormone choice for the final stretch of a stronger recomp plan.
proposition.mobileSummary: A harder finishing option for recomp.

editorial.guidance: Compare MENT with RAD-140 and LGD-4033 to decide whether the plan needs maximum mass, strength-led intensity or a lean-mass base.
editorial.considerations: Review the full product detail and the advanced intensity profile before adding it.
